summary: Untrusted PR gate allowed list: when sdk-python py files and sdk-go go files may be added

options.description: Keep the list until the gate sandbox runs the Python and Go suites, then widen it to sdk-python/**/*.py and sdk-go/**/*.go
Widen the list now, before the sandbox runs those suites
Keep the list as it is; the operator reviews outside Python and Go pull requests by hand

body: Problem: allowedMutationGlobs of the untrusted PR gate did not list sdk-python/**/*.py or sdk-go/**/*.go, so Stage 1 refused every outside pull request to the Python or Go SDK (#2683). The gate sandbox ran only the Node suite, so a widened list would have admitted Python and Go changes that no sandbox suite tested. Ruling: the list stays as it is until the sandbox runs the Python and Go suites; then it is widened to those two globs. The rejected options of the rubric were not kept in the ledger; the two listed here are the alternatives as the planner recalls the choice.
